About the Project

The Future Fluid Dynamics CDT supports doctoral research into fluid behaviour and its applications. This is a cohort-based training programme at Leeds, with research projects selected through the CDT's admission and funding process. University of Leeds is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on Future Fluid Dynamics CDT PhD, University of Leeds 2027. The work sits within Mathematics, Engineering. The role is based in Leeds, United Kingdom. Funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as GBP 21,805/year (2026/27 reference rate). Applications close 7 January 2027.

Research Areas

  • Fluid dynamics
  • Mathematics
  • Engineering

About the University of Leeds

Leeds offers research degrees through its schools, institutes and doctoral training programmes. Its funding routes include subject-specific studentships, university scholarships and awards with particular nationality or widening participation criteria.

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Full announcement and application portal: https://fluid-dynamics.leeds.ac.uk/programme/

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 7 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 7 January 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
